reason: I'll make the cut first so the platelet plug has a break to gather at.
expectation: The rough edge will break the skin and a small vessel, making a place for platelets to gather.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes are labelled as helping make reinforcing threads, but I want to see the break first.

effect: The cut reaches a leaking blood vessel, so I can now gather platelets at the break.
reaction: The intact surrounding skin makes the small breach easy to see.
reason: Platelets stick to the torn vessel and each other, so I'll form the plug first.
expectation: The platelets will gather into a plug that slows the leak, though it may still need reinforcing threads.

alternatives.reason: The labelled enzymes can help make the reinforcing threads, but I want to form the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, but the surface cut remains open and the plug still needs reinforcement.
reaction: It is clear how the platelets help without closing the whole cut.
reason: The only offered combination uses the labelled enzymes to make the reinforcing threads.
expectation: The enzymes will help the dissolved clotting protein form threads that can reinforce the plug.

effect: The clotting proteins formed a mesh, and the new goal is to stop the bleeding.
reaction: The branching mesh makes its reinforcing role clearer.
reason: The only offered combination puts the threads together with the platelet plug.
expectation: The mesh will reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding, though the surface cut may remain.

effect: The reinforced plug stopped the bleeding, but the surface cut still needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the mesh and platelets work together without pretending the whole cut had healed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding while the skin remains open.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the protein threads was less engaging on its own; the enzyme label largely gave the pairing away, and it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The plug slowed the leak before the threads reinforced it, and stopping bleeding did not close the surface cut.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though I followed the enzyme label rather than understanding the detailed chemistry of thread formation.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter to see how the still-open skin heals; this chapter left a clear question.
